_doc: Treatment and urban water-supply facts for the Krishnagiri map, from the urban local bodies' own progress sheets, the industry register and SIPCOT's projects page. Every figure is as the cited page prints it on the date read; nothing is reconciled across sources.

Positions: the Santhapuram STP site is the Santhapuram revenue village (TNGIS generic_viewer:revenue_villages, Hosur taluk, LGD 933511) centroid; the 20.13 MLD STP's site village is printed only as 'Ramanaikken' (trade press) and matches no revenue village in the TNGIS register, so it is carried on the Hosur Corporation record rather than as a point. ULB records sit on the OSM place node of the town.

The register's 'Sewage treatment plant of Krishnagiri Municipality' (consent 2017) keeps its register position; its operating status is unverified: the municipality's sewerage page says the town has no underground drainage, while an NHAI permission request shows a sewer line being laid along NH-48.

registerStp.statusNote: On the TNPCB register as 'Sewage treatment plant of Krishnagiri Municipality' (Red, Large, consent year 2017, Agasipalli); the municipality's sewerage page says the town has no underground drainage, and a sewer line along NH-48 is being laid (NHAI permission request). Whether the plant operates is not stated by any page read.

sipcotTtro.name: SIPCOT TTRO plant, Hosur (20 MLD)
sipcotTtro.asPrinted: TTRO Plant, Hosur, Krishnagiri: capacity 20 MLD, investment Rs.182 crore, inaugurated by the Chief Minister on 13/06/2023; 'With a planned capacity of 20 MLD, this facility aims to provide treated water sourced from Kelavarapalli Dam to cater to the water needs of the Hosur SIPCOT Industrial Estate'; serves Hosur SIPCOT (2,092 acres), Shoolagiri SIPCOT (989 acres) and a forthcoming 1,800-acre park, about 800 units
sipcotTtro.note: SIPCOT's page gives no site for the plant, so the fact is carried on the estates it serves rather than drawn as a point.
